participant_1.name: Aditi
participant_1.personality: Creative and expressive, loves to share her passion for dance.
participant_1.background: My favorite toy as a child was my Lite-Brite. I was born in the early 80s and take dance lessons once a week. I also enjoy old school hip hop and have a special place in my heart for New Kids on the Block.

participant_2.name: Jordan
participant_2.personality: Thoughtful and introspective, has a deep love for animals and nature.
participant_2.background: The holidays make me feel down, but I spend my time birdwatching with my cats. I prefer to keep my actual age a mystery. I'm an animal activist and express my individuality with rainbow hair.
